## Reading and hierarchy

Ordinary **primary prose** explains a [linked idea](#controls) without fading into supporting metadata. This specimen checks headings, a long enough paragraph to inspect the sixty-five-character reading measure, and font roles in both deliberately authored modes.

<div class="reading-display">Editorial display</div>

### A subordinate heading

- A readable list uses the same prose face and size.
- Labels and navigation use the UI face.

<figure><svg role="img" aria-label="A simple comparison chart" viewBox="0 0 480 120" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect x="30" y="20" width="200" height="24" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="30" y="60" width="320" height="24" fill="currentColor"/></svg><figcaption>Figure 1. A caption uses the supporting role.</figcaption></figure>

## Controls

<div class="reading-groups">
<section><p><a id="sample-link" href="#states">Read the states</a></p>
<p><button id="primary" class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Primary action</button> <button id="secondary" class="btn btn-secondary" type="button">Secondary action</button></p>
<p><button id="outline" class="btn btn-outline-primary" type="button">Outline action</button></p>
<p><button id="selected" class="btn btn-primary" type="button" aria-pressed="true">✓ Selected</button> <button id="disabled" class="btn btn-primary" type="button" disabled>Unavailable</button></p>
<label class="form-label" for="name">Your name</label><input id="name" class="form-control" value="Ada" />
<label class="form-label" for="choice">Choose a mode</label><select id="choice" class="form-select"><option>First choice</option><option>Second choice</option></select>
<p><input class="form-check-input" id="checked" type="checkbox" checked /><label class="form-check-label" for="checked">Checked choice</label></p>
</section>
<section><label class="form-label" for="invalid">Required identifier</label><input id="invalid" class="form-control" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="invalid-message" value="?" /><p id="invalid-message" class="error-message">⚠ Error: enter a valid identifier.</p><div class="card"><div class="card-body"><h3>Bounded panel</h3><p>Primary prose remains readable on a panel. <a href="#states">Panel link</a></p></div></div></section>
</div>

## Code and tables

An `inline_code` phrase stays distinct without becoming tiny.

```python
from statistics import mean
values = [1, 2, 3]
print(mean(values))
```

| Component | Expected behavior |
|:---|:---|
| Prose | Primary ink on paper |
| Panel | Primary ink and distinct link |
| Focus | Visible outline |
